## DIAL: Storytelling, THE GOLD STANDARD

### Gold 1, Juniper & Captain Nibbles, morning visit
> "Captain Nibbles was at the door before I had my key out. Juniper watched from the stairs. Cap's bowl was empty in a minute and Nibbles asked for more. Junipers are also a kind of tree."

**Why it works:** Cap drives the story and Juniper gets the last word.

### Gold 2, Tofu (Marlowe), evening walk
> "Tofu and I took the long way round. Tell Marlowe the gate is latched."

## DIAL: Professional

### Intro (to Odette)
> "Hi there! It's Joss with the team. Juniper is welcome any time."
